description: Change auth settings (`settings`, a partial object: site_url, uri_allow_list, jwt_exp, ...) and/or one provider (`provider` such as google, github, apple, email with `provider_config` such as {enabled, client_id, secret}). Applied to the running auth service. Needs an owner or admin. Scope: auth:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

name: auth.config.set
title: Change auth settings
